body:
Re-checked thoroughly. **Zero schema mismatches found.**

Ran `npx astro check` — no errors. Dev server: `[content] Synced content` clean. Programmatic frontmatter-vs-schema comparison of all 9 files: every file has all 7 required fields (id, title, description, category, image, technologies, featured) and optional fields (link, github) where present. No missing fields, no wrong types, no extra fields.

HTML output confirms all 9 projects present in SSR: ReviewIt, Lugetech, Maad Radio, Hitman, Lyricut, SSH Thing, Domain Echo, Scan.gy, SecretNotez.

**The schema is correct and all content validates.** The "no projects" issue is not a data/schema problem — it's a client-side hydration/visibility issue (Framer Motion `initial={{ opacity: 0 }}` not transitioning when JS fails to load). No schema fix needed. No .mdx changes needed.
